svg.text: Tamagi 1.0 ("Kazunobu M") — Commands & Innovations
Immutable atomic Linux desktop for AI workflows, native Chromium WebApps, and self-healing operations
1. CORE ARCHITECTURAL INNOVATIONS
Immutable Atomic Core & Self-Healing Boot
• Composefs + systemd-boot: Verity-backed read-only /usr booted
directly from an 8 GiB /efi partition — no /boot ext4 or GRUB bloat.
• Cosign & Secure Boot guard: Refuses unsigned OCI pulls and blocks
OS swaps if Secure Boot is enabled without Universal Blue's MOK key.
• 2-strike boot recovery: boot-check disables layers on 1st failure;
runs bootc rollback and quarantines the faulty digest on 2nd strike.
bootc composefs · cosign policy · tamagi boot-report
Aeon-Style Installer, Hybrid USB & /var/home Keep
• Automatic home preservation: Detects home, @home, legacy
ostree deploys, separate /home, and LUKS2 encrypted containers.
• Zero-wipe OS upgrade: Merges ext4 /boot into EFI, migrates via
Btrfs reflink, keeps UID/GID, SELinux labels, and Snapper history.
• Bulletproof USB ISO: xorriso -partition_offset 16, lean live
initramfs, English default screens, and Direct I/O bit-verified flashing.
tamagi-detect-home · write-usb.sh · tik + bootc
Armored Btrfs + Snapper Separation
• No storage collapse: bootc owns OS (/); Snapper snapshots ONLY
/var/home/<user>. Root Snapper configs are blocked & flagged.
• Isolated subvolumes: Containers, Flatpaks, Steam, Lutris, and VMs
live in dedicated subvolumes outside snapshot trees (zstd:1).
• PSI OOM + GC guard: systemd-oomd 80% user slice pressure guard
+ auto snapshot prune & composefs-gc when free space < 15 GiB.
home-snapshots prune 15 · 20-tamagi-oomd.conf
Transactional Updates & Reversible Sysext Layers
• transactional-update ergonomics: flock locking, pre-update
home snapshot, check, drop, rollback, history, --soft-reboot.
• Native EROFS sysext layers: tamagi-layer (Rust) overlays Fedora
RPMs (libvirt, Steam, Chromium) cleanly onto read-only /usr.
• Non-blocking rebuilds: tamagi-layer-rebuild.service updates
stale overlays in idle after boot so OS upgrades never stall login.
tamagi update [--soft-reboot] · tamagi layer add
Native Chromium, ChromeDriver & ChromeOS WebApps
• Pre-installed Chromium + ChromeDriver: Ships natively with
Omarchy Google Account OAuth2 sign-in (tamagi browser google-account).
• ChromeOS-grade integration: Wayland IME, PipeWire WebRTC
screen share, touchpad history swipe & ~/.config/chromium-flags.conf.
• Upgraded PWA WebApps: Auto manifest/high-DPI icon fetch, shared or
--isolated profiles, COSMIC dock pinning, and 16 one-click presets.
tamagi webapp presets · tamagi webapp install --isolated --pin
Local AI, Project-Jailed Agents & Declarative OS
• Bubblewrap AI jails: Claude Code, Codex, opencode & Qwen run
isolated to your repo (SSH keys/tokens hidden) + git/btrfs checkpoints.
• Built-in llama.cpp AI: Offline GGUF assistant (Super+Shift+A),
plus AI-summarized update changelogs and diagnostic triage.
• GrapheneOS hardening & tamagi.toml: hardened_malloc, USBGuard,
and single-file declarative OS provisioning (tamagi apply).
tamagi agents run claude · tamagi harden · tamagi apply
